english: "A History of Dry Top" by Nicholas Sanford, 1070 A.E.
"A Treetiss on the Eccentricities of the Hive Mind"? Ah, yes, one of my finer works—

"Always may your waters flow to quench the land and seeds you've sown."
—Old Elonian Blessing
"And I shall harvest the souls of the unbelievers."
"And so we allied with Glaust, a magical being of great power, to find a way."

"And when they see that their efforts to stifle my fire elemental research has led me to the much more promising venture of harnessing energy from sparks, they will be doubly dismayed. But I will not rejoin them. Never."
"As we see an increase in tourism and travel, we've also seen an increase in kappa-related casualties."
"By now, you must know that it was a sylvari saboteur that brought down the Zephyrites, someone they'd welcomed into their airborne community. Tragic, to see such ideals exploited and brought low."
"Caudecus the Wise has gone to Divinity's Reach to knock some sense into the council—three cheers!"
"Desist, my dears, or you'll be dead!"
"Divinity's Reach plays politics and leaves us to defend ourselves against the centaurs."
"Dwayna, goddess of air and life, beloved to me. She is the promise of salvation whispered in my ear, the silent resolve to continue on. How my heart longs to bask in her light once again." —Malchor
"From our camp here, we interviewed the Zephyrite survivors and the peaceful, welcoming centaurs of Restoration Refuge, here in the uplands of Dry Top."
"Get mesmers out of our government! How can we trust mind-shapers to argue fairly for the people?"
"Grenth, Prince of Ice, God of Death. He embodies inevitability, the idea that all things have a time...and that time must inevitably pass." — Desmina
"Hagen." Below the name are three lines of weathered runes. Only one word in each line is legible. Armorer, merchant, storage. Which line do you read?
"Here atop Viewing Hill, the hero Frye Fireburn of the Flame Legion, along with his warband, were forced to witness the doom of charr and humans alike in the sorcerous destruction of Ascalon City."
"Hoknil the Lesser." Below the name are three lines of weathered runes. Only one word in each line is legible. Azure essence, tusk, wing. Which line do you read?
"I am but a simple man of peace, my only thirst for victory was to see my art take shape, to leave something behind. But in seeing Balthazar, even my spirit felt the fiery call to battle." —Malchor
"I am the scythe, the bringer of salvation."
"I saw a group of merchants attacked by a brutish norn who claimed to be working for the Shining Blade. How can the queen condone these unwarranted assaults?"
"I want to move to the city and become a landscaper!" I said. "What could go wrong!" I said.
"I wasn't accepted into the Shining Blade's ranks, but they will take on a criminal sylvari? Just what are they thinking?"
"In the presence of Melandru, I felt my weariness wash away, as if rejuvenated by the sweet embrace of spring. Wherever she walked, the sun shone, and I felt the beauty of life." —Malchor
"It's time to enforce order in the countryside. I propose that the Seraph muster in force to secure Krytan soil."
"Kessex Hills is all but barren after invasion by the snake-men and sylvari. The crown must repair our holdings in the area!"
"Little Thom." Below the name are three lines of weathered runes. Only one word in each line is legible. Archer, healer, brawler. Which line do you read?

"Lyssa, when gazing upon you, I see beauty, but it is ephemeral. The illusions fade upon your passing, and leave me to wonder if I ever knew you at all. And yet, I knew I could not look away." —Malchor
"Makar Thoughtslayer." Below the name are three lines of weathered runes. Only one word in each line is legible. Merchant, innkeeper, collector. Which line do you read?
"Merin Trollsbane." Below the name are three lines of weathered runes. Only one word in each line is legible. Azure essence, tusk, wing. Which line do you read?
"Minister Caudecus fights for us—get the rest of the council replaced!"
"Most of being a senior officer is just managing personalities."
"My new family," that Mabon person called them.
"My shipment of goods was burgled by pirates barely a stone's throw from Divinity's Reach! How can we be allies with the known criminals of Lion's Arch?"
"Newton." I remember hearing that in the Dream and thought it would make a good dog name.
"Olrun called upon the Spirits for advice, and Owl replied, 'To build a family on strength alone is to carve a nest of stone.' Then Olrun was pleased, for she had chosen a kindly mate."
"Our survey expedition arrived here from the Priory in 1327 AE, just after the Zephyrite airships fell victim to sabotage and crashed. We used their Aspect skills to reach these high cliffs."
"Please do not feed or pet the kappa, and under no circumstances should you look one in the eyes for over two seconds."
"Rest in peace, Bowan Westkeeper, in your absence the world has become a darker place."
"Reyna." Below the name are three lines of weathered runes. Only one word in each line is legible. Archer, healer, brawler. Which line do you read?
"Savio had gotten to know a villager from Prosperity...well, before she was killed in the Mordrem attack on that mining town in Prospect Valley. He took her loss very hard."
"Tharn Stonerift." Below the name are three lines of weathered runes. Only one word in each line is legible. Monk, ranger, warrior. Which line do you read?
"The Shining Blade is employing vagrants and charr to harass our citizens."
"The Shining Blade say they will protect Kryta, but don't expect them to protect YOU."
"The airships of Lion's Arch pass overhead more frequently than ever while the queen plays with clockwork dolls."
"The charr can't be trusted. Once the dragons are defeated, their greedy eyes will turn to our lands, just like years ago."
"The crown's watchwork soldiers barely lasted a week before they were stolen! Surely this is a sign of foul play at work close to the throne."

"The diagrams on the subsequent pages illustrate my proposal for a large-scale device to convert mystical energy into a form usable by standard megaenergstatic machinery." Someone has "corrected" the diagrams in red ink.
"The mind sees truth the eye cannot."
"The ministry hides behind the walls of Divinity's Reach, but what are we to do out here?"

"These past few months have been a trial, but no trial cannot be overcome by the great genius Tork! Progress is beginning to pick up. The device I have been constructing is nearly complete and has a high chance of success."
"Though Fireburn had warned his brethren of King Adelbern's trap, they disregarded his pleas and stormed the city, leaving Fireburn and his warband bound upon Viewing Hill."
"To hear Bear or Wolf is to know fear, for their enemies cannot overcome them. To hear Owl is to know peace, for her enemies will never hear her coming."
"Unfortunately, our pack dolyak Suzie was too simple a creature to learn such tricks. We couldn't leave her to starve, nor could we afford to waste her meat. She nourished us for the trek ahead."
"Volsung." Below the name are three lines of weathered runes. Only one word in each line is legible. Armorer, merchant, storage. Which line do you read?
"Want to find...uh, roots...dirty sticks..." There, done.
"We're continuing west from here, in hope of reestablishing contact with the inhabitants of Maguuma Jungle. May Kormir light your way.—Explorer Kitabu, with Explorers Savio and Amoxtli"
"We've continued on up into the cliffs. Remember us to Erghen Cragstrider, and take care.—Explorer Kitabu, with Explorers Savio and Amoxtli"
"When Adelbern's magic devastated the city, Fireburn and his warband were the only survivors. They spread news of the tragedy and live on in legend."

"When my success is confirmed, my immediate plan is to drag all of my gadgetry to Rata Sum and show those obstinant simpletons how utterly in error they were! They will regret casting me out and beg for my return."
"When the charr attacked, the king fled. Now the queen hides from the centaurs. Krytans need to stand and fight!"
"While our heroes fight dragons in distant lands, our homes are under attack. When will the crown's protection return?"
"Who it once was"? What do you mean?
"You too will be forgotten once your duty is done."
%str1%! Are you off to find adventure? Is your Wyld Hunt song pounding in your ears?
%str1%, it is nice to see you again. Hope you've been well. Care to trade any excess items for shinies?
%str1%, we of the Durmand Priory can't thank you enough for your contribution. You will be remembered.
'Ey. Out here to take care of that beast? Nasty one. Watch out—got an eyeball liable to turn ya into a boulder.
'S a good thing I built up a resis-resis-resistance to their poison. Doesn't affect me one bit.
'Til the end of the world—and with heroes like you fighting for it, I expect that will be a long time to come!
'Vengeful' is way too small. Caudecus is 'venge-over-full.'
